topic: Data factor selection and aggregation status
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on determining the correct data factor for the metro/rail stage dataset within MOPs. It was confirmed that the 'release' factor should be used, not a previous version (e.g., 19). The participant noted that while a fresh ML factor was created for easier comparison, the report being used seems to rely on an older factor. A decision was made regarding adjusting the data by limiting signal levels differently.

Later in the day, one participant stated they would re-aggregate all data and provide an update within a couple of hours to allow time for analysis with another team member.
decisions: Use the 'release' factor for the metro/rail stage dataset in MOPs.
action_items: One participant will re-aggregate all data and provide an update by the evening.
